## Context / Problem
`examples/agent-skills/rebar-debug/SKILL.md` (854 lines) mandates a fresh worktree from
`origin/main` (lines 40-52) and a Step-7 sibling sweep (lines 741-785), but has **no step
before Phase 1** that (a) searches the tracker for an existing report or (b) establishes which
build the bug was reported against. Verified against the tree:
`grep -c 'Step 0' SKILL.md` = 0; `grep -i duplicat SKILL.md` = no match; no mention of a
reported-against version. The only tracker-search text is one advisory bullet inside Stage 1
(line 205, "Prior fixes & regression history … tracker search") which is about *prior fixes*,
is not a gate, and records no link/resume/file decision. The search-before-file rule otherwise
lives only in `AGENTS.md`.

Scale (verified, `rebar list --type bug`): 764 bug tickets, **759 closed**, 249 filed 7–21 Aug
2026 — closed tickets dominate, so an open-only sweep is nearly blind. Task
`eac3-ed70-764a-4f9e` is the complementary tracker-side duplicate detection.

## Approach
Insert a top-level section `# Step 0 — Orient` into SKILL.md **after** the "Approval gate"
section and **before** the "Triage: full protocol or fast path?" section, so it precedes
`# Phase 1` on **both** the full protocol and the fast path. It has three actions; each writes
one line into the Stage 1 dossier (which is prose in SKILL.md — there is no `phases/`
directory and no separate template file).

**(a) Tracker sweep.** `rebar search "<symptom words>"` — full-text over
titles/descriptions/comments/tags across **all statuses, including closed tickets** (759 of 764
bug tickets are closed, so `--status open` alone misses the corpus) — plus
`rebar list --type bug --status open,in_progress` for in-flight work. Outcome is recorded
either as "no existing ticket found for <queries>" or as a link/resume: link the new report
`duplicates` the existing ticket (the `duplicates` relation exists — `rebar link --help`), or
resume the existing one instead of filing.

**(b) The reported-against floor.** A rebar ticket has **no `rebar-version` field** (verified:
absent from `src/rebar/schemas/ticket_state.schema.json`; the only `rebar-version:` in the
tree is the signing-manifest stamp in `src/rebar/_signing_manifest.py`, unrelated to tickets).
Two real sources, in order:

1. **The report text** — a `rebar --version` output, a commit sha, or a release tag quoted in
   the bug's description or comments. Authoritative when present.
2. **The ticket's `created_at`** — `ticket_state.schema.json:42-44` documents it as an
   **integer of nanoseconds** (`time.time_ns()`), e.g. `1787354756915214001`. `git --before=`
   accepts an approxidate or `@<unix-seconds>` — it does **not** accept raw nanoseconds, and
   silently mis-reads a 19-digit value as far-future seconds, returning the tip. Measured in
   this checkout: `git rev-list -1 --before="1787354756915214001" origin/main` → `960fbfef2f`
   (the tip); `git rev-list -1 --before="@1787354756" origin/main` → `767bb3ead6` (a real
   historical floor). So the skill states the conversion explicitly:
   `git rev-list -1 --before="@$(( <created_at> / 1000000000 ))" origin/main`, and notes that
   `created_at` is nanoseconds and the divide is required.

The result is a **floor**, not the exact build, so the dossier line reads "reported on or after
<sha>". Step 0 then runs
`git log --oneline <floor-sha>..origin/main -- <suspect paths>` so the hypothesis stage knows
whether the suspect code changed since the report. If **neither** source is available, Step 0
records "reported-against version unknown" explicitly and the hypothesis stage treats the whole
history as in scope, rather than silently assuming `main`.

**(c) Worktree currency.** Confirm `git rev-parse HEAD` equals `git rev-parse origin/main`;
if not, record that rather than proceeding silently on a stale tree.

**Approval-gate consistency.** The Step-0 `duplicates` link is an own-tracker writeback, so it
is added to the pre-approved list in the "Carve-out — the project's own tracker" paragraph
(SKILL.md lines 121-127), which today enumerates only the RCA comment, the `caused_by` link,
the Step-7 sibling tickets, the not-a-bug comment, and the final report comment. Without this,
Step 0 would mandate an action the same file gates behind user approval.

## Scope
- `examples/agent-skills/rebar-debug/SKILL.md` — the new `# Step 0 — Orient` section and the
  carve-out list amendment.
- `tests/unit/test_rebar_debug_step0.py` — new content gate (see Testing).

Not in scope: `docs/user-guide.md` (verified: mentions neither `rebar-debug` nor
`agent-skills`); `examples/agent-skills/rebar-debug/phases/` (no such directory — that dir
holds only `SKILL.md`, `llm-behavioral-taxonomy.md`, `test-design.md`);
`examples/agent-skills/shared/test-design.md` (untouched, so the byte-identical-copy gate
`tests/unit/test_skill_shared_sync.py` is unaffected).

## Testing
A new unit test `tests/unit/test_rebar_debug_step0.py`, modelled on the existing
`tests/unit/test_flaky_test_guidance.py` doc-content gate, pins the load-bearing halves:
Step 0 exists and is positioned before `# Phase 1`; all three actions are present; the
nanosecond→seconds conversion is spelled out; the raw-nanosecond form is **absent**; the
unknown-version case is present; the sweep is not open-only; and the carve-out lists the
Step-0 link. Existing gates `tests/unit/test_check_skill_frontmatter.py` (driver
`scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py`) and `tests/unit/test_skill_shared_sync.py` keep passing,
as does `make lint`.

## Acceptance Criteria
Let `S = examples/agent-skills/rebar-debug/SKILL.md`.

- [ ] Step 0 exists and precedes Phase 1: `grep -n '^# Step 0 — Orient' "$S"` returns exactly
      one line, and its line number is **less than** that of `grep -n '^# Phase 1' "$S"`.
- [ ] All three actions are named in `S`: `grep -c 'rebar search'`, `grep -c 'rebar list --type
      bug --status open,in_progress'`, `grep -c 'git rev-list -1 --before="@'`, and
      `grep -c 'git rev-parse origin/main'` are each `>= 1`.
- [ ] The nanosecond conversion is explicit **inside the runnable command**, and the broken
      form is gone: `grep -c 'nanoseconds' "$S"` >= 1,
      `grep -cF 'git rev-list -1 --before="@$(( <created_at> / 1000000000 ))" origin/main' "$S"`
      >= 1, and `grep -c -- '--before="<created_at>"' "$S"` equals `0`.
- [ ] No ticket `rebar-version` field is referenced: `grep -c 'rebar-version' "$S"` equals `0`.
- [ ] The unknown case is explicit: `grep -c 'reported-against version unknown' "$S"` >= 1.
- [ ] The sweep is not open-only: `grep -c 'including closed tickets' "$S"` >= 1.
- [ ] The approval-gate carve-out pre-approves the Step-0 link: the paragraph beginning
      `**Carve-out — the project's own tracker.**` contains `Step-0 duplicates link`
      (`grep -c 'Step-0 duplicates link' "$S"` >= 1).
- [ ] Gates pass: `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_rebar_debug_step0.py
      tests/unit/test_check_skill_frontmatter.py tests/unit/test_skill_shared_sync.py -q`
      exits 0, and `make lint` exits 0.

## Review remediation (2026-08-21, rv9)
Blocking fixed: (1) floor source #2 piped a nanosecond `created_at` straight into
`git --before=`, which silently returns the tip — the `@<unix-seconds>` conversion is now
stated with the measured shas above; (2) Scope named a non-existent
`tests/unit/test_skill_frontmatter.py`; the real file is `test_check_skill_frontmatter.py`.
Advisories fixed: the non-existent `phases/` directory leaves Scope; the unverifiable "dossier
template text" AC is replaced with anchored greps. Also corrected against the tree: the
worktree mandate spans lines 40-52 (not 40-43); `docs/user-guide.md` has no rebar-debug
content, so it leaves Scope; bug counts are reproduced from `rebar list --type bug`.
